response.overview: "Glances" stems from my interest in the gaze through video, combined with a desire to explore the medium of painting. What happens when the camera observes a painting? How does the light and colors stand out? Do we see details we didn't notice before?  We're used to seeing works of art through images, which change our perception of them. In "Glances," the painting is studied as an object—not so much its content, but its purely material aspect.  A project for the Chromatology course, conceived as a looping installation.
response.title: Glances
